# /map-codebase

Record the relevant as-is product, architecture, contracts, state/data,
operations and testing knowledge in the existing Memory Bank.
Apply `.memory-bank/workflows/execute-loop.md#working-policy`: consult the operator on substantive choices unless autonomy was explicitly granted; carry out settled decisions without repeated approval.

Choose direct exploration or permitted delegation according to repository size.
Link substantial evidence when useful; avoid a separate report duplicating the
Memory Bank. Preserve accepted target decisions and distinguish them from what
the code currently does. Code alone does not authorize new requirements,
architecture decisions or product tasks.

Keep evidence, inference and unresolved questions distinguishable. Update
navigation for the documents actually changed. If a PRD/delta is already
provided, retain it for the requested work; otherwise ask only when the next
product change needs it. Mapping itself can finish without a PRD.
Return the baseline paths, material gaps and the next useful action; no fixed
planning chain follows automatically.
